description:
The chairman of MS Group, Moon Junhyuk’s father, was murdered by his mistress. He was shot to death—and, to make matters worse, alongside Junhyuk’s stepmother. With scandalous rumors spreading everywhere and the family’s reputation already in ruins, Moon Junhyuk, the chairman’s only son, struggles desperately to protect the company while seething with anger. Then one day, he happens to meet Han Iseol and discovers that she is the younger sister of the woman who killed his father. After the humiliating deaths of his father and stepmother—the very people who had tormented him throughout his life—Junhyuk is looking for someone to take his anger out on, and he chooses Iseol as his target. His plan is simple: approach her as a kind and affectionate man, make her fall in love with him, become her boyfriend, and then cruelly abandon her just to make her suffer. But Iseol is also a victim, a woman carrying wounds every bit as deep as Junhyuk’s. As the two grow closer, what began as deception slowly turns into a sweet and genuine love. However, Iseol knows nothing about Junhyuk’s true identity or the revenge scheme that brought him into her life. When she finally discovers the truth, she is devastated.
